title: Water Cycle Evidence notebook clarity
method: Frozen actual runtime with owned ephemeral server and isolated Chromium. Exact stored changes/status/readings, native disclosure/writing/replay/remove/undo/clear/download, rendered geometry and scoped accessibility. Complete and realistic earlier fixtures plus typed malformed saved-value stress. No learner tabs, port8770, source edits or Git writes.
